newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Mercer County, N.J..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
The County of Mercer, New Jersey
County College Bonds, Series 1997
(Book-Entry Only)
SEALED BIDS will be received by the Treasurer, County of Mercer, New Jersey (the County''), at the McDade
Administration Building, 640 South Broad Street, Trenton,
New Jersey 08650, on
Wednesday, July 23, 1997
until 11:00 a.m. (Eastern Daylight Time) for the purchase of
the County's College Bonds, Series 1997 (the Bonds'') as
more fully described in the full Notice of Sale:
PRINCIPAL AMOUNT: $2,000,000
DATED: July 15, 1997
DENOMINATION: $5,000 each or integral multiples
thereof, except as to
that portion of the Bonds which if not divisible by
$5,000 will be in the denomination of $1,000 or integral
multiples thereof.
MATURITIES:
Year Principal Year Principal
(July 15) Amount (July 15) Amount
REDEMPTION: The Bonds are not subject to redemption
prior to maturity.
INTEREST: Each bid must specify the rate of interest
the Bonds are to bear, expressed in a multiple of 1/8 or
1/20 of 1% per annum payable initially on January 15,
1998 and semiannually thereafter on July 15 and January
15 in each year until maturity. The Bonds will be sold
to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in
accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice
of Sale.
CLOSING: July 30, 1997.
Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the County's
full Notice of Sale, containing additional terms and
conditions of the public sale and bid form may be obtained
from the County Treasurer at the McDade Administration
Building, 640 South Broad Street, Trenton, New Jersey 08650,
telephone number (609) 989-6694.
/s/ Steven H. Zielinski
Treasurer
(From The Bond Buyer)
